summary.content:
Today's selection covers 42 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 29 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Infuriating Google commercial imagines the founding fathers embracing AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: How Meta’s Threads Became as Popular as X
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 6 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.description: As OpenAI and Anthropic prepare to go public, tech workers making six figures are grousing that they cannot compete with the new A.I. elite. Some doubt they can afford to stay.

top.description: Two hundred and fifty years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence, a new commercial asks: What if the Founding Fathers had access to Google Workspace?

top.description: The social platform that Meta once positioned as a rival to Elon Musk’s X now has 500 million monthly users. It increasingly resembles Reddit.
